newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Shell Singapore's 11,000 T/day cracker restarts.
newsitem.headline: Shell Singapore's 11,000 T/day cracker restarts.

text.p: Shell Singapore restarted its 11,000 tonne per day thermal cracker January 24 after shutting down for maintenance January 13, a company spokeswoman said on Monday.
She said the unit was back running at its normal, full capacity.
The unit cracks heavy residual fuel to produce between 30-40 percent of middle distillate. The remainder of the output is fuel oil.
The spokeswoman said the cuts in throughputs at the 435,000 barrel-per-day were being maintained.
The spokewoman had told Reuters on January 17 that runs were being cut by 4,000 tonnes per day (30,000-bpd) amid weak refining margins.
